items.title: Show HN: Agent-hop – a Rust TUI that hops a live Claude Code chat into Codex
items.contentSnippet:
Hi HN! Agent-hop is a TUI which allows you to use multiple coding agents and lets you hop between agents mid-chat. So, if you are using Claude Code and you do not want to lose context in another agent, you could just hop to another agent (Codex, Pi, Grok Build, OpenCode).
It initially started as a resume and search tool, but I noticed some friction in that, and so I decided to create my own TUI.
How is this different from Herdr? Herdr does not allow you to hop between agents live.

items.title: Show HN: Which LLMs have the best sense of humor?
items.contentSnippet:
What if LLMs were good banter?
Well we tested which LLMs have the best sense of humor.
More specifically, we tested 16 top LLMs align most with human sense of humor. We ran >100k judgements and got >1.6k human ratings to see where do we agree across clean and dark jokes.
The main findings:
- Gemini 3.7 Flash has the best taste at 64% although it's really close at the top
- However, we've trained our own judge that reaches 74%
- Humans agree up to ~80%, the other part is subjectivity

items.title: The fix for the AI agent that hijacked a company's DNS: it can propose the change, but it can't approve it
items.contentSnippet:
